head: codex/csdlc-v3-gh-architecture
title: [planning][C-SDLC v3] Complete the reviewed Rust architecture and implementation plan
body:
Closes #73

Completes the planning-only Rust architecture for C-SDLC v3, modeled on the official GitHub CLI's one-binary command architecture while preserving ADL's typed lifecycle and safety boundaries.

The packet defines the complete command, application context, state, pending-intent, transaction, card, Git, GitHub, PVF, review, publication, finish, cleanup, migration, security, portability, observability, and testing architecture. It includes 18 independently bounded implementation specifications plus separately authorized V3-R01 retirement. No implementation child issue, selector change, migration, cutover, or v2 deletion is included.

Validation:
- all 19 specifications contain objective, scope, non-goals, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria, validation proof, and stop conditions
- exact Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Claude Sonnet 4.6 post-fix reviews: PASS with no unresolved P0/P1 findings
- exact pre-PR subagent review: PASS with no remaining P0-P3 findings
- local comparative link, all ten pinned cli/cli source paths, Mermaid render, reviewed-scope stability, doctor, and diff hygiene: PASS

Residual lifecycle note: one STP deliverable line retains the initial fourteen-issue denominator because typed v2 editing rejects STP collection mutation in implemented phase. SIP scope, STP acceptance, SRP scope, canonical issue #73, and the reviewed plan all carry the final eighteen-issue denominator; no card hand edit or lifecycle bypass was used.
